description: Get the tokenized real-world asset market by segment (treasuries, gold, stocks, credit, real estate, …): USD value and net flow over 1, 7 and 30 days, token counts, the market total, tokenized stocks by exposure, the largest issuers per segment and the products that moved most. Value = circulating × the token’s latest USD price; flow = change of circulating at today’s price. Whole US dollars. Stablecoins are not included.
name: get_rwa_overview
title: Tokenized RWA Market Overview
